# Lead Machine — Canada shop tools

Free in-browser tools for Canadian shops. No login. Not tax advice. CRA published figures win.

## Hub
- https://abstractigakis.com/shop-tools

## Tools
- GST/HST/PST calculator (add or remove tax, 2026 rates): https://abstractigakis.com/ca/hst.html
- Calculatrice TPS/TVH/TVP: https://abstractigakis.com/ca/tvh.html
- CRA 2026 mileage allowance: https://abstractigakis.com/ca/km.html
- Canadian invoice generator: https://abstractigakis.com/ca/invoice.html
- 2026 TFSA / RRSP room: https://abstractigakis.com/ca/tfsa.html
- HVAC / plumbing / electrical website generator: https://abstractigakis.com/ca/build.html

## Data
- 2026 sales-tax and mileage rates (JSON): https://abstractigakis.github.io/lead-machine-demo/rates-2026.json
- Sources: CRA GST/HST rates; Finance Canada 2026 automobile allowance (73¢/67¢ provinces, 77¢/71¢ territories). Nova Scotia HST is 14%. Quebec QST is 9.975% on the GST-inclusive price.
